title: prmarmot-cli pr@1
description: What `prmarmot-cli pr OWNER/NAME#N --json` prints: one pull request as the board's `pr` object (board@1), classified as in Involving me, plus whether GitHub still has it open. Within pr@1 fields are only added, never renamed or removed, so ignore fields you don't know.

status.description: open: still open. merged / closed: GitHub still returned it, so `pr` carries its last state. inaccessible: GitHub returned nothing for it (no such PR, or this token cannot see it); `pr` is null and the command exits 1.

pr.description: The PR as `board@1` prints it, with the app's attention marks; null when `status` is inaccessible.
